title: Fix subscription activation bypassing payment flow

requirements.text: Fix the bug in SubscriptionPackagesPage where clicking a 'Subscribe' button activates the subscription immediately without initiating a Stripe payment flow. The subscription must NOT be activated or recorded in the local store until a successful Stripe checkout session is confirmed. The correct flow is: (1) user clicks Subscribe, (2) app initiates a Stripe checkout session (or shows Stripe configuration prompt if not configured), (3) user completes payment on Stripe, (4) PaymentSuccess page confirms the session and only then activates the subscription. Remove any code path that writes a subscription record to localStorage or marks a plan as active before payment confirmation.

quotes: I clicked on the subscription, and it activated without asking to pay the amount

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Subscribe' on any plan in SubscriptionPackagesPage does NOT immediately activate the subscription or update local storage with a new subscription record.
Clicking 'Subscribe' triggers the Stripe checkout flow (redirects to Stripe or shows Stripe configuration prompt if Stripe is not yet configured).
The subscription is only recorded as active after the PaymentSuccess page confirms a valid Stripe session ID.
If Stripe checkout is cancelled or fails, the user is redirected to PaymentFailure and no subscription is recorded.
In demo mode only, a clearly labelled 'Demo Subscribe' simulation is acceptable — but live mode must always require Stripe payment.
The 'subscriptions' localStorage store is not written to from SubscriptionPackagesPage directly outside of demo mode.
Verified by navigating to /subscription as a non-demo authenticated user and confirming that clicking Subscribe redirects to Stripe checkout rather than immediately activating the plan.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Demo mode simulation of subscription activation (in DemoModeButton/seedDemoData) is acceptable and must not be broken.
All payment processing must go through Stripe only — no Razorpay references.
nonGoals: Changing subscription plan prices or features.
Modifying the Stripe backend integration or PaymentSuccess verification logic unless directly needed to fix this bug.
Changing the UI design or layout of SubscriptionPackagesPage beyond the fix.
